title: MindWatcher: Toward Smarter Multimodal Tool-Integrated Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a tool-integrated reasoning agent (MindWatcher). It introduces new models, training methodologies, and a benchmark (MWE-Bench) for assessing multimodal reasoning and tool use. The content does not contain any component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
